time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0
units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of 4 background patches vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.1 px every frame
camera.view: top-down (overhead) view of an office desk; desk plane roughly parallel to image; man seated at top edge of desk; mild perspective (desk top edge y~780, objects lifted toward camera appear larger)

scale_hint: Internet convention: one scale = prior world value / prior pixel value, measured the same way (e.g. object pixel length along main motion direction, or along its own long edge).

folder.description: navy-blue clipboard/folder holding an A4 chart sheet (world map on one half, blue/purple bar table with red cells on other half). The ONLY object that is carried across the scene.
folder.distinguish_from: the "CONTRACT" clipboard (white text page, navy board, silver clip) it lies on at start, which stays put at left; the static Business Goals sheet (bottom centre); chart papers at right

board_size_frame0_px.note: flat on desk, long edge oriented ~127 deg (down-left); top corner hidden under sleeve, completed as rectangle

folder.board_size_frame35_note: frame 35 corners TL,TR,BR,BL; edges TL-TR, TR-BR, BR-BL, BL-TL. Folder is held up and tilted (top away from camera): long axis (map->bars) foreshortened to ~430 px, short axis 391 (far/top) to 457 (near/bottom).

extent_along_main_motion_dir_px.note: projection of the board quad onto the net motion direction (-16.8 deg); folder is rotated relative to motion so this is near its diagonal at frame 0

man.description: man in dark charcoal suit and glasses, seated behind the desk (top of frame), seen from above; face is blurred in the footage
man.track: tracks/man.csv (head box/centre by template matching; body mask approx)

man.shoulder_span_px_frame35: approx 1100 (x ~1390 to ~2510 from body mask; arms included, rough)
